column1: # ZAP scan rules configuration for Bookshelf API
# This is a JSON API (no HTML rendering). Rules that produce false positives for
# pure JSON APIs are set to IGNORE; critical injection/execution rules are FAIL.
# ── IGNORE: false positives for a JSON API ────────────────────────────────────

column3: Incomplete or No Cache-control Header — JSON API responses intentionally omit Cache-Control
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — source comments not present post-deploy
Charset Mismatch (Header Versus Meta Charset) — not applicable to JSON responses
Timestamp Disclosure — ISO timestamps in JSON responses are intentional

column1: # ── IGNORE: infra-layer false positives (Cloudflare/Render bypass FastAPI middleware) ──

column3: X-Content-Type-Options Missing — header set by middleware; alert fires only on infra-level 403s outside FastAPI
Strict-Transport-Security Not Set — HSTS set in production middleware; infra-level responses bypass FastAPI
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy Missing — CORP header now set by middleware; infra-layer responses excluded
Proxy Disclosure — intentional Cloudflare + Render reverse proxy chain, not a real disclosure

column1: # ── WARN: track but do not fail the build ─────────────────────────────────────

column3: CSP Scanner — false positive; default-src 'none' covers all fetch directives for this JSON API
Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — API uses JWT Bearer tokens, not cookie-based sessions
Cross-Domain Misconfiguration — review after Cloudflare proxy is active
Weak Authentication Method — JWT Bearer is used; flag if ZAP misidentifies scheme
Application Error Disclosure — any detail in error bodies warrants review
Permissions Policy Header Not Set — header IS set by middleware; alert if ZAP reports absent

column1: # ── FAIL: hard failures — any finding blocks the pipeline ─────────────────────
